summary: Kforce Inc. filed an Item 8.01 Form 8-K on September 16, 2026, disclosing entry into a Rule 10b5-1 corporate stock trading plan on September 15, 2026, tied to its board-authorized share repurchase program. The plan permits open-market repurchases from no earlier than September 16, 2026 through October 28, 2026, executed through an independent broker subject to price, market, volume and timing constraints. No price per share, aggregate dollar amount, share count, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is stated. The structure provides a safe-harbor mechanism for buybacks during any closed windows. Watch actual repurchase pace and possible program expansion.
